answer: Require each new identity to survey one unclaimed plot on a public canyon of unpaid tasks and to mint a unique jade seal whose serial is burned on reuse. Three stewards drawn from a rotating nebula who have never reviewed one another must attest that the survey was actually performed and that the seal has never appeared on another plot. A sybil factory cannot mass-register aliases because each name consumes a single-use plot, a unique seal, and a one-time steward trio; colliding seals are rejected at admission.
